summary: Candidate is a distinct micro_skill in error_handling/logging domain with unique objective (contextual error logging with specific exception types and structured messages). It does not semantically overlap with existing skills (which cover JSON parsing, platform routing, and future exception inspection) or peer candidates (which focus on async wrapping, agent instrumentation, and exception-to-event conversion). The candidate addresses a core logging pattern not covered by peers. Support evidence from Debugging Roadmap validates the approach.
